## Photolysis networks from KINETICS-base input (`from_kinetics_base`) {#sec-ch07-kinetics-base}

### Summary

kintera can build its photochemistry options from the input files of the KINETICS-base model: a master input, a
photolysis catalog and a directory of cross-section files. The same reader also builds the thermal kinetics of
@sec-ch06-kinetics-base. This section is a skeleton: only the entry points are filled in.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** `PhotoChemOptions` from KINETICS-base files.

**Data.** File paths in; options out.

**Placement.** Setup only.

**Activation.** API `PhotoChemOptions.from_kinetics_base(master, catalog, cross_dir)`.

**Guarantee / limits.** Not drafted.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer.
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: this is an input reader. The mapping of catalog entries to branches and cross sections is not drafted.
At the pin a photolysis reaction of the master file with no catalog entry gets zero cross sections, so its $J$ is 0
with no warning; this holds for 5 of the 8 photolysis reactions of the in-tree test data (row K39).[^ch07-k39]
